verdict.rationale: HubSpot's developer docs state you can create up to 10 test accounts to test apps and integrations without affecting any real HubSpot data. That directly delivers the core of an isolated test environment separate from production. Missing for 10: details on how test accounts are provisioned and seeded with data, any documented way to point the MCP server or CLI-driven agent workflows at a test account, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
